translation_references.msgid:
“But the Seneschal gathered the toadstool fly-bane.”
    -Adam Mickiewicz, _Pan Tadeusz_, III. 1834.
     trans. G.R. Noyes, 1917.
translation_references.msgstr:
“而总管采集的是毒蝇伞。”
    -Adam Mickiewicz, _Pan Tadeusz_, III. 1834.

translation_references.msgid:
Your accursed nature makes it harder to dispel malignant energies from your
being, reducing the rate at which you can recover from Doom and Banes.
translation_references.msgstr: 你的诅咒本质让恶性力量更难从身上驱散，使你从厄运和厄咒中恢复得更慢。

translation_references.msgid:
Your skill with your highest weapon skill (at the time of becoming afflicted by
this bane) is reduced by 50% and your skill with your two highest skills among
magical schools, Invocations, and Evocations are reduced by 25%.
translation_references.msgstr: 在受到此厄咒时，你等级最高的武器技能会降低50%；在魔法学派、祈祷和唤发之中，等级最高的两项技能会降低25%。

translation_references.msgid:
When you are badly injured and alone, a reaper may come to claim you. These reapers
will be immune to all damage from non-adjacent sources and, if your XL is less
than 14, will additionally be slow. At higher XL, multiple reapers may appear at
once.

When this bane is lifted, all reapers summoned this way will immediately vanish.
translation_references.msgstr:
当你身受重伤又孤身一人时，收割者可能会前来索命。这些收割者免疫不与其相邻的来源造成的所有伤害；若你的经验等级低于14，它们的还会行动缓慢。经验等级较高时，可能同时出现多名收割者。

此厄咒解除时，以这种方式召来的所有收割者都会立即消失。

translation_references.msgid:
Jinxing spirits encircle you. When you attack foes, those who fail a Will check
are jinxed, taking damage and becoming drained. The spirits depart quickly when
no foes are in sight.
translation_references.msgstr: 施加厄咒的灵体环绕着你。你攻击敌人时，未通过意志检定的目标会受到厄咒，承受伤害并受到吸能。视野内没有敌人时，这些灵体会迅速离去。
